Callout.Name: Hunter Injured
Callout.Message: Hunter injured in the field, another hunter on the phone.
Callout.Advisory: Gunshot wound to the leg, conscious, remote location.

Script.Line: It came out of the treeline. I did not see a face.
He is on the ground and he is still talking. That is good, is it not?
We are both licensed. Neither of us should be getting shot at.

Lines.Approach: Shot in the leg and he is a long way from a road. The ambulance is not going to reach him on its own.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
